name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the Houthis' missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia and on ships in the Red Sea, and calls for an immediate ceasefire in Yemen. It asks the EU to add the Houthis to its terrorist list, send more warships to protect shipping, and give more aid to Yemen. It also wants the EU to help with energy prices and to push for peace talks led by the United Nations.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU to act; EU governments decide.
- **Who it affects:** Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Iran, shipping, EU households and businesses.
- **What happens next:** EU governments and the foreign policy chief consider the requests.
